newsitem.title: USA: Little Switzerland mulls business combination.
newsitem.headline: Little Switzerland mulls business combination.

text.p: Little Switzerland Inc said Thursday it had instructed its financial adviser, Wasserstein Perella & Co Inc, to discuss possible business combinations with certain third parties.
Little Switzerland said there can be no assurance it will enter into any transaction.

The company is a specialty retailer of brand name watches, jewelry, crystal, china, fragrances and accessories. It operates 24 stores on 10 Caribbean islands, and three stores in Alaska. Its primary market consists of vacationing tourists attracted by free-port pricing and duty-free allowances.
